ns2:section.sectionText: A weekend field trip to Dixon Springs in southern Illinois for ESE majors and professors that investigates the environment of Southern Illinois, examining the ecology, geology and sustainability of the region. Activities will include a writing workshop, a tour of Midwestern forests and wetlands, nature photography, and a geological hike. The trip begins on the evening of Friday the 7th of September and returns on Sunday the 9th of September. Grading will be S/U (pending approval by the Provost office). The School is subsidizing most of the weekend's food, travel and accommodation costs. There is a field trip fee of $25.
